description.value: A McDonald's drive-through and dine-in restaurant on Mount Newton Cross Road in Sidney, serving the full Canadian menu including burgers, chicken, breakfast, and McCafé beverages. Located on the Saanich Peninsula, it is a practical stop for touring cyclists moving between the BC Ferry terminal at Swartz Bay and the rest of Vancouver Island. The drive-through layout and takeaway options make it a quick resupply point for food and drinks.

address.value: 2473 Mount Newton Cross Road, Sidney, BC
